cat > auto.py <<'PY'
import arena,chess,os,sys,subprocess
for i in range(int(sys.argv[1])):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b): print('RESULT',arena.result(b));break
 safe=[]
 for m in b.legal_moves:
  b.push(m)
  repeat=b.is_repetition(3)
  # Avoid an immediate repetition the opponent can force.
  for r in b.legal_moves:
   b.push(r);repeat|=b.is_repetition(3);b.pop()
  b.pop()
  if not repeat:safe.append(m.uci())
 env=dict(os.environ,ROUNDS='2',ROOTS=' '.join(safe))
 p=subprocess.run(['python3','analyze.py','30'],env=env,text=True,capture_output=True)
 lines=p.stdout.splitlines();best=[l.split()[1] for l in lines if l.startswith('bestmove')][-1]
 print('\nTURN',b.fullmove_number,'FEN',b.fen(),flush=True)
 print('\n'.join(lines[-3:]),flush=True)
 b=arena._request('move '+best)
 print('PLAYED',best,'REPLY',b.peek().uci(),'RESULT',arena.result(b),flush=True)
